resources.string: Your mosque\'s iqamah times from Masjidbox, with the next prayer highlighted
The part after masjidbox.com/prayer-times/ in the mosque\'s link, or paste the whole link.
Only used when the mosque\'s web page lists adhan times but not iqamah (e.g. Chingford Mosque).
To add the widget: long-press an empty space on your home screen, tap Widgets, find Iqama Times and drag it onto the screen. Tap the widget any time to come back here.
